note: Walter, Donny and the Dude between frames

dish.make_ahead: Burger sauce up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Blanch in oil at 140C for 5 minutes and drain.
Cool the chips for 15 minutes (included in cook time).
Fry again at 185C until crisp and season with salt.
Divide the mince into 8 loose balls and smash thin on a hot griddle. Season.
Cook 2 minutes per side until cooked through, then melt the cheese over the patties.
Toast the buns, mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard for the sauce, and fill each bun with two patties, onion, pickles and sauce. Serve the chips alongside.

note: snacks at the lanes between frames

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef mince with 1 diced onion in a large pan.
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes and kidney beans and simmer 25 minutes until thick.
Simmer the beef franks for 5 minutes, then sear on a hot griddle until blistered.
Toast the hot dog buns.
Fill each bun with a frank and a spoon of chilli, then top with the cheddar, the rest of the diced raw onion and mustard.

film: Back to the Future Part II (1989)
note: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza steel or heavy tray inside.
Top the mini bases with a little sauce and cheese and bake for the reveal.
Stretch the dough as thin as you can and spread with the crushed tomatoes.
Scatter over the mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.

note: Chicago deep dish with mozzarella, Italian sausage and garlicky crushed tomato

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Press the dough mixed with butter into a deep greased tin.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic.
Layer the mozzarella, then sausage, then tomato.
Finish with parmesan and bake at 220C.
Rest before slicing.

note: Chicken thighs in a dried chilli, almond and dark chocolate sauce

dish.n: Chicken mole with rice and tortillas
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Toast the chillies and soak in hot water.
Blend with the almonds, garlic, cinnamon and stock.
Simmer the sauce and melt in the chocolate.
Add the chicken and simmer until tender.
Cook the rice, warm the tortillas and serve with the chicken.

film: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009)
note: Turkey breast rolled around sage and onion sourdough stuffing, roasted

steps.text: Fry the onion with the sage in the butter.
Mix with the torn sourdough and season for a stuffing.
Butterfly the turkey breast.
Spread with the stuffing, roll and tie.
Chop the potatoes.
Roast the turkey at 180C with the potatoes around it, rubbed with oil.
Rest the turkey.
Cook the sprouts and toss with butter.

note: Grilled rosemary lamb chops, mashed potatoes, peas and pan gravy

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Rub the chops with rosemary, garlic and salt.
Grill hot on each side and rest.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.
Cook the peas.
Make gravy in the pan with the juices and stock.

note: Grace, the cop they both fall for, and her Puerto Rican cooking

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat with a splash of stock

steps.text: Brown the chicken in a wide lidded pan until golden, then set aside.
Fry the onion, capsicum, garlic and coriander in the same pan until soft.
Stir in the annatto, rice, olives, capers and stock and bring to a simmer.
Sit the chicken on top, cover and cook on low until the rice is tender.
Rest, covered, before serving.

dish.make_ahead: Soak, blanch and press the sweetbreads up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the veal sweetbreads in cold water in the fridge for 2 hours.
Simmer the sweetbreads in salted water for 4 minutes, then plunge into iced water and peel off the membrane.
Press the sweetbreads under a weighted tray in the fridge for an hour.
Slice into 2cm pieces, dust with the flour and pan-fry in 30g of the butter for 3 minutes a side until golden.
Deglaze the pan with the chicken stock and lemon juice, reduce by half, then swirl in the remaining 20g cold butter and spoon the sauce over the sweetbreads.

note: the dinner Norman ruins

dish.make_ahead: Brine the turkey overnight

steps.text: Stir the salt into the water and brine the turkey breast, covered, in the fridge.
Brine the turkey overnight.
Pat the turkey dry, rub with butter and cut the potatoes and pumpkin into chunks.
Roast the turkey at 170C until 70C inside, with the potato and pumpkin roasting alongside.
Rest the turkey, covered. Bake the stuffing mix as the packet says.
Make gravy from the pan juices, flour and stock. Slice the turkey and serve with everything.

note: the meal Popeye watches through the window

dish.make_ahead: Sauce best made just before serving

steps.text: Reduce the vinegar with tarragon and shallot until almost dry. Cut and dry the chips.
Fry the chips at 140C, then drain.
Whisk the yolks with the reduction over low heat until thick, then drizzle in the warm butter to make the sauce.
Sear the steaks hard, then rest.
Fry the chips again until crisp and serve with the steaks and sauce.

note: Beef chuck, potatoes and carrots slow-cooked in rich stock

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Chop the onions, potatoes and carrots.
Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions, return the beef with the flour, stock, potatoes and carrots.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.

note: Pan roasted chicken in white wine and Dijon tarragon cream, creamy potato gratin

dish.n: Tarragon cream chicken with potato gratin
dish.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer with part of the cream and the garlic and bake at 160C.
Pan-roast the chicken breasts until cooked through.
Add the wine, Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then the remaining cream, and simmer.
Steam the beans.
Serve together.

note: Topside roasted rare to medium rare, with gravy from the pan juices

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the beef with oil, salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk into a smooth batter and leave to rest.
Roast the beef until the centre reads 52C on a probe.
Rest the beef under foil. Raise the oven to 220C, heat the oiled tins until smoking, pour in the batter and bake the puddings until risen and golden.
Make gravy by simmering the stock with the pan juices until slightly thickened. Carve and serve.

note: slow roast pork shoulder with crackling, rice and pigeon peas

dish.make_ahead: Marinate overnight; cooked pork reheats well

steps.text: Stab the pork all over and rub with garlic, oregano, salt and vinegar. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Roast skin up at 160C for 5 hours.
Raise the oven to 230C for 20 minutes to crackle the skin.
Cook the rice with the drained pigeon peas, stock and onion until tender, and serve alongside the sliced pork.

note: Chicken braised in garlic, vinegar, soy and bay leaves

dish.make_ahead: Adobo up to 2 days ahead, fry the rice fresh

steps.text: Crush the garlic.
Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the garlic, vinegar, soy, bay leaves, peppercorns and water.
Simmer uncovered, turning, until the sauce is sticky.
Fry the cooked rice with crushed garlic in oil until crisp in spots.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the adobo over the rice with an egg on top.

note: Charred rare beef sliced paper thin on rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce

dish.make_ahead: Beef can be sliced up to 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Rub the beef with the salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred outside and rare inside.
Rest, then slice paper thin.
Pile onto rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce.

note: Juniper rubbed venison backstrap, seared rare, with redcurrant sauce

dish.n: Van Pelt's juniper venison and redcurrant

steps.text: Peel and boil the parsnips and potatoes until soft.
Crush the juniper with the pepper and thyme and rub over the venison.
Sear in a hot pan, a few minutes a side for rare.
Rest the venison.
Add the stock and redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce until glossy, then whisk in a little of the butter.
Mash the vegetables with the remaining butter and serve with the sliced venison.

note: Gina's dad's restaurant, where the family drops in

steps.text: Soak the clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge, then rinse.
Gently fry the garlic and chilli in some of the olive oil, add the clams and wine, cover and steam for 4 minutes until open.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with parsley and more olive oil.

note: Seared rump steaks basted in garlic butter, with baked potatoes

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C
Season the steaks
Sear in a smoking pan, then add the butter, garlic and thyme to baste and pull at 54C inside
Rest
Wilt the spinach with the cream and serve alongside

note: Roast salmon with lemon dill butter and crushed potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and crush with some of the butter.
Roast the salmon skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes.
Melt some butter with the lemon juice and dill and spoon over.
Steam the beans.

note: Roast lamb racks carved into cutlets, roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas

dish.n: Mayor's roast lamb cutlets and mint sauce

steps.text: Cut the potatoes and pumpkin and roast at 200C.
Roast the lamb racks alongside at 200C until 56C inside.
Roast the vegetables until golden.
Rest the lamb, then carve into cutlets. Cook the peas.
Mix chopped mint with the vinegar, sugar and hot water for the mint sauce.

note: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta, lemon butter, potato gratin

dish.make_ahead: Stuff up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta.
Cut a pocket into each chicken breast and fill.
Slice the potatoes, layer in a dish with cream, garlic and seasoning, and bake alongside the chicken at 200C.
Sear the chicken, then roast with the gratin.
Melt the butter, whisk in lemon juice and spoon over the chicken.

note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic parsley butter, double fried fries

dish.n: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries.
Fry twice until crisp.
Split the lobster tails and brush with garlic parsley butter.
Grill until just cooked.
Serve with the fries and lemon wedges.

note: Chicken thighs baked over creamy mushroom rice

steps.text: Brown the chicken and set aside.
Soften the mushrooms in the same pan, then stir in the rice, stock, cream and thyme.
Pour into a baking dish, lay the chicken on top and cover.
Bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

note: Pork shoulder roasted until it pulls apart, tangy cider vinegar sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheat covered

steps.text: Rub the pork with salt and roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Simmer the vinegar with the brown sugar and chilli flakes.
Shred the pork and toss through the sauce. Shred the cabbage for a slaw and dress it with a splash of the sauce.
Pile the pork into buns with the slaw.

note: Smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles, onion, special sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Roll the mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and a chopped pickle for the sauce.
Smash each ball flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip and top with cheese.
Toast the buns. Stack 2 patties per bun with sauce, sliced pickles and diced onion.

note: Beef fillet strips with mushrooms, paprika, brandy and sour cream sauce

steps.text: Slice the beef, mushrooms and onion.
Sear the beef fast and set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter, add the paprika and flame the brandy.
Add the stock and simmer.
Cook the noodles and butter them.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef.

note: Lobster salad with celery and chives in a toasted buttered bun, homemade chips

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips once at a lower heat, then again hot until crisp.
Chop the lobster and fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery and chives.
Butter and toast the split buns and fill.

note: Isaac and Tracy watching old movies

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in some of the soy and the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the chillies and Sichuan pepper in hot oil, then add the chicken and stir-fry.
Add the vinegar, remaining soy, sugar and Shaoxing and toss until glossy.
Add the peanuts and spring onions and serve with rice.

note: Grilled teriyaki chicken thighs with charred pineapple and rice

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the soy, the mirin, the brown sugar, the grated ginger and the garlic clove for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Marinate the chicken thighs in half the sauce for 30 minutes.
Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce.
Grill the pineapple slices 2 minutes a side.
Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken and serve with pineapple, sesame, spring onion and sliced chilli in vinegar.

note: Steamed clams in white wine with bacon, potato and celery

steps.text: Steam the clams open in the wine, then strain the liquid
Render the bacon, then add the onion, celery and potato
Add the clam liquid and milk and simmer
Stir in the cream, clams and thyme

note: Beef rissoles simmered in onion gravy, with mash and peas

steps.text: Mix the mince with one grated onion, the carrot, egg, breadcrumbs and Worcestershire
Shape into eight rissoles
Fry until browned
Make gravy with the other sliced onion, flour and stock
Simmer the rissoles in the gravy
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas

note: Chicken, pearl barley and vegetable soup with parsley and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the vegetables.
Simmer the chicken with the barley, carrots, leek and celery in the water for an hour.
Shred the chicken back into the pot, then stir through the parsley and lemon juice. Serve with brown bread.

note: Triple decker chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich, twice fried fries

dish.n: Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into shoestrings and fry once.
Grill the bacon and toast the bread.
Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each and cut into triangles.
Fry the fries a second time until crisp.

note: breakfast for the marines, served at dinner

dish.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk.
Mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, onion, Worcestershire, salt and pepper, and shape into a loaf on a lined tray.
Glaze with the tomato sauce and bake until at least 75C in the centre.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with the butter and warm milk.
Rest the loaf, slice and serve with the mash.

note: Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce, with potatoes

steps.text: Mix the mince, onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt.
Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce.
Bake at 180C until cooked through.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Slice the meatloaf thickly and serve on the mash.

note: Pork and beef meatballs simmered in San Marzano tomato sauce with basil

dish.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the bread in the milk, squeeze and mix with the mince, egg and half the parmesan.
Roll into balls and brown in the oil.
Simmer in the tomatoes with basil.
Cook the spaghetti.
Toss with the sauce and serve with the rest of the parmesan.

note: Lamb marinated overnight with garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled and rested

dish.make_ahead: Marinate overnight

steps.text: Marinate the lamb overnight with garlic, rosemary, lemon and oil
Grill over high heat until 55C inside
Rest
Chop the parsley, capers, garlic and lemon with oil for salsa verde
Slice the lamb and spoon over the salsa

note: Beef, carrot and celery tomato sauce tossed with spaghetti and parmesan

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mince in the oil, then add the carrot and celery and soften.
Add the tomatoes and simmer, stirring now and then.
Cook the spaghetti and toss through the sauce. Cover with plenty of parmesan.

note: Grilled rib eye with garlic parsley butter, battered onion rings

dish.n: Action hero rib eye with onion rings

steps.text: Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.
Slice the onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry at 180C until golden. Drain.
Season the steaks and grill over high heat for medium rare.
Rest the steaks, top with the garlic butter and serve with the onion rings and rocket.

note: Honey thyme chicken drumsticks roasted with potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Toss the drumsticks with the honey, garlic, thyme and some of the oil.
Chop the potatoes and slice the carrots.
Roast at 200C alongside the vegetables, turning once.
Serve on one big tray.

note: the dinner they could have had years earlier

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in 140C oil until cooked but pale, drain and cool.
While the frites cool, season the steaks.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Sear the steaks in a heavy hot pan with oil on both sides.
Lower the heat, add the butter and thyme and baste briefly, then rest the steaks.
Add the peppercorns to the pan, then the brandy, carefully and away from the flame, and simmer briefly.
Add the stock and reduce, then stir in the cream and simmer. Serve with the steaks and frites.

film: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994)
note: Seared kangaroo fillet with roast sweet potato wedges and warm plum sauce

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss in oil and roast at 200C.
Rub the kangaroo with the pepperberry, crushed garlic and oil.
Roast the wedges until golden.
Sear the fillet hard in a hot pan to keep it rare.
Rest the fillet, then slice. Warm the plum sauce and serve alongside.

note: Yoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onions

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt and garam masala for 2 hours.
Rest the chicken in the fridge.
Slice the onions and fry until crisp, soak the saffron in warm milk.
Par-cook the rice in boiling water.
Layer chicken, rice and onions in an ovenproof pot, drizzle with saffron milk and seal tightly.
Bake at 170C.

note: Slow braised beef chuck chili with chipotle and kidney beans, sour cream, cornbread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Dice the beef, onion and garlic.
Brown the beef in batches.
Add the onion, garlic, chipotles and cumin, then the tomatoes and drained beans. Braise until tender.
Bake the cornbread as the packet says.
Serve with sour cream and squares of cornbread.

note: Butter roast turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing

dish.n: Scrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffing

steps.text: Rub the turkey with some of the butter, salt and pepper.
Roast at 180C.
Fry the onion in butter, mix with the breadcrumbs, sage and egg, press into a dish and bake alongside for the last part of the roasting. Roast the potatoes in oil.
Simmer the apples with the sugar and water until soft.
Rest the turkey. Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.

note: Josh and Billy loose in the city

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days, reheat gently

ingredients.item: brown onions, one halved and two sliced

steps.text: Simmer the franks in water with the halved onion, then griddle until blistered.
Soften the sliced onions in oil, add the tomato paste and vinegar.
Steam the buns.
Fill with franks, mustard, sauerkraut and onions.

note: Shaved rib eye with onion, peppers and melted provolone on long rolls

steps.text: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes.
Shave the steak paper thin and slice the onions and capsicum.
Fry the onion and capsicum on a hot plate until soft.
Add the beef and sear fast.
Lay provolone over the top to melt.
Scoop into split bread rolls.

note: Brown sugar and Dijon glazed ham with potato salad and green beans

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, glaze and bake on the day

steps.text: Score the ham skin and rind. Mix the brown sugar, Dijon and orange juice into a glaze and brush it over.
Bake at 180C, basting often, until the glaze is sticky and deep golden.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last few minutes. Drain, cool and toss with the mayonnaise.
Rest the ham for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the potato salad.

film: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days (2003)
note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato and basil sauce, tossed through rigatoni

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the mince with the breadcrumbs and egg, season and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and torn basil and simmer.
Cook the rigatoni, toss through the sauce with plenty of parmesan.

note: Dry-brined seared rib eye with garlic butter and baked potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine overnight

steps.text: Salt the rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Dry-brine overnight.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Crisp the bacon.
Sear the steaks, finish at 200C to 54C inside and rest.
Top with garlic butter, slice to share and load the potatoes with sour cream and bacon.

note: the Brooklyn newsies' lunch

steps.text: Griddle the franks over medium-high heat until blistered and piping hot.
Steam the buns until warm.
Fill each bun with a frank, mustard and sauerkraut, then wrap in food-safe paper.

note: Triple-decker toasted club with roast chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato

steps.text: Grill the bacon until crisp
Toast the bread
Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato with mayo across three slices per sandwich
Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips

note: Eggs, bacon, potato and cheddar rolled in flour tortillas with salsa

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and fry with the bacon until crisp.
Scramble the eggs softly in the butter.
Warm the tortillas and fill with eggs, bacon, potato, grated cheddar and salsa.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

note: Cold poached pork loin sliced thin under a tuna, anchovy and caper mayo

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Poach the pork gently in salted water until 63C inside.
Chill the pork.
Blitz the tuna, anchovies, capers, mayonnaise and lemon juice until smooth.
Slice the pork thin and cover with the sauce and more capers.

note: Beef short ribs braised 4 hours in stout and thyme, over buttery mashed potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the ribs all over in the oil.
Add the onions, thyme and stout, then water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C for 4 hours until falling apart.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter.
Serve the ribs on top of the mash.

note: the big chain's cafe

steps.text: Spread the sourdough with cranberry sauce.
Divide the turkey and brie among four slices and close.
Butter the outsides.
Press in a hot sandwich pan or frying pan weighted with a second pan, turning once, until golden and the brie melts.
Cut each sandwich in half.

note: Paprika pork rib tips glazed with tangy barbecue sauce, piled over white bread

ingredients.item: pork ribs, cut into short pieces

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic and salt.
Cover and roast at 150C until tender.
Cut the potatoes into fries, toss in oil and bake at 220C until crisp.
Uncover the ribs, brush with barbecue sauce and roast hot until sticky.
Pile the ribs over slices of white bread with the oven fries.

note: Creamy arborio risotto with roast pumpkin

steps.text: Roast the pumpkin at 200C until soft.
Stir the rice in butter.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time.
Mash half the pumpkin through, fold in the rest with parmesan.
Fry the sage leaves in butter and spoon over.

film: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018)
note: Chicken pieces braised in red wine with bacon, small onions and mushrooms

steps.text: Peel the onions and potatoes and slice the mushrooms.
Brown the chicken and lardons.
Add the onions and mushrooms, then the wine, stock and thyme.
Simmer covered.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.

note: Beef and pork ragu layered with béchamel and mozzarella, baked 45 minutes

dish.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mince.
Simmer with tomatoes and red wine.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, bechamel, lasagne sheets and mozzarella.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.

note: Panko crumbed white fish fingers, oven chips, peas and tartare sauce

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast at 220C.
Cut the fish into fingers and crumb in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow-fry the fish in batches.
Cook the peas.
Serve with tartare sauce.

note: Crisp-skinned duck breast, red wine cherry sauce and buttery mashed potatoes

dish.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce
dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Score the duck skin and render skin side down over medium heat.
Roast at 200C, then rest.
Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.

note: Grilled rump, parsley chimichurri, sweet potato wedges, broccolini

dish.n: Red One's training day steak plate

ingredients.item: large sweet potatoes, cut into wedges

steps.text: Toss the sweet potato with the oil, paprika and salt and roast at 220C.
Blitz the parsley, garlic, chilli, vinegar and olive oil into chimichurri.
Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.
Grill the broccolini.
Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with the wedges and broccolini.

note: Beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce over spaghetti, garlic butter baguette

dish.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Mix the mince with the breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan and roll into balls, then brown.
Simmer in the tomatoes with half the garlic.
Cook the spaghetti and toss with the sauce.
Split the baguette, spread with the butter mixed with the remaining garlic, and bake at 200C.

film: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966)
note: Borlotti beans simmered with smoked ham hock, tomatoes and rosemary

dish.make_ahead: Soak beans overnight

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight and drain.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the beans, ham hock, tomatoes, rosemary and water to cover.
Simmer until thick.
Shred the ham back in and serve with bread.

note: Beef chuck stewed in brown ale under puff pastry

steps.text: Slice the onions and brown the beef in oil.
Brown.
Add the onions, ale and water to cover and simmer.
Thicken with the flour, spoon into a pie dish and top with pastry brushed with egg.
Bake at 200C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas.
Cook.

note: Roast turkey breast with stuffing, cranberry sauce and roast potatoes

steps.text: Rub the turkey with some of the butter and the herbs.
Roast at 180C.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the onion, chopped sage and melted butter and bake the stuffing alongside the turkey.
Toss the potatoes in oil and roast on another tray.
Rest the turkey and serve with stuffing, cranberry sauce and potatoes.
